evidence_locator_policy: Each supported gold value is explicitly located in paragraph 0 of its case source; absent fields have no evidence locators.

cases.source_text: This work investigates electrochemical energy storage. We propose a graphene-based membrane and measure 93.2% ionic selectivity. The method uses impedance spectroscopy. The membrane is intended for water purification. A limitation is short-cycle stability.

We study lithium battery capacity degradation at high temperature. Cells were tested with electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and showed 81% capacity retention after 500 cycles. No commercial application is stated.

This paper introduces a convolutional neural network for classifying satellite images. The model achieved 91.0% accuracy on the held-out dataset. The work does not report clinical use or human effectiveness.

We report a statistical model of coastal rainfall using 20 years of observations. Rainfall was correlated with sea-surface temperature. The study used linear regression. No causal relationship was established and no deployment target is specified.

main_results: rainfall was correlated with sea-surface temperature

cases.source_text: The work evaluates a microfluidic sensor for glucose measurement. Researchers tested the sensor in mice and observed a 12% signal increase. The stated application is laboratory monitoring. No human efficacy or patent is claimed.
This study investigates polymer membrane selectivity. We fabricated a polymer membrane and measured 88% salt rejection. Desalination is not mentioned. The experimental protocol uses filtration tests.

We analyze an agricultural time series with a Bayesian model. The method estimates uncertainty intervals but reports no measured performance result. Machine learning and commercial deployment are not stated.

The project studies optical waveguides for environmental sensing. A silicon nitride waveguide was fabricated and tested. The result was a 4.1 dB transmission loss. The authors identify river monitoring as an intended application.

We investigate protein folding using molecular dynamics simulations. The simulation reproduced a known folding pathway. The study does not claim a new therapeutic application, patent, TRL, or commercial readiness.

This research examines urban heat islands. We used satellite temperature observations and a spatial regression model. Areas with sparse vegetation were associated with higher surface temperature. The paper recommends urban monitoring but does not claim mitigation effectiveness.

main_results: sparse vegetation was associated with higher surface temperature

cases.source_text: We present a battery electrode made from manganese oxide. The electrode delivered 210 mAh/g in a laboratory test. The work investigates electrochemical storage and identifies grid storage as a possible application. The authors note that cycling stability remains limited.

The article describes a remote sensing classifier trained on multispectral images. It uses a random forest algorithm and obtained 76% accuracy. No machine learning label beyond the named algorithm, no human diagnosis, and no patent statement are provided.

This work measures the response of a wearable strain sensor. The sensor showed a linear response over the tested range and an average hysteresis of 3.5%. The authors state that rehabilitation monitoring is an intended use. Results were collected from a benchtop setup.

We study antibiotic resistance in a bacterial culture. The experiment used broth dilution and found no significant improvement with the tested compound. The research problem is resistance measurement. No clinical application is reported.

main_results: no significant improvement with the tested compound

cases.source_text: The study develops a thermal imaging pipeline for building inspection. It uses infrared cameras and reports a 6.8% mean detection error on the benchmark set. Building inspection is the explicit application. The authors state that performance outside the benchmark was not evaluated.

limitations: performance outside the benchmark was not evaluated
